Please note: Covert Risk is a full-length Christian romantic suspense prequel with a stronger small-town romantic suspense feel than the main Hightower Security novels.

She knows everyone's secrets.

His could get them killed.

For ex-CIA officer Luke Easton, an undercover assignment at a luxury hunting and fishing lodge in Maine should have been a cakewalk. But all his carefully laid plans go up in smoke when family friend—and notorious gossip—Chloe shows up, risking his cover and his entire operation.

Chloe isn't just vacationing—she's lying low. After a week of anonymous harassment and escalating threats, the hunting lodge seems like the perfect place to disappear. Running into a highly trained soldier and spy seems like an answer to her prayers—until she finds herself playing the role of Luke's fake wife.

With Luke's operation under threat and enemies closing in, Chloe is no longer hiding from her own problems—she's caught in the crossfire of his.

Now he's duty-bound to protect her.

Whether he likes it or not.
